newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran launches four-day military exercise in Gulf.
newsitem.headline: Iran launches four-day military exercise in Gulf.

text.p: Iran's army and the naval forces of its Revolutionary Guards on Sunday launched amphibious military exercises in the Gulf, the official Iranian news agency IRNA said.
"The war games are to last for four days in the Persian Gulf waters to enhance the combat readiness of participating forces," IRNA said, but gave no further details.

Iran's Revolutionary Guards commander was quoted earlier on Sunday as saying Iran had no intention of starting a war, but said it would turn the region into a slaughterhouse for U.S. forces if they attacked.

"Iran will never start any war, but if the Americans one day decide to attack us, then they would have committed suicide. We will turn the region into a slaughterhouse for them. There is no place better than the Persian Gulf to destroy America's might," Major General Mohsen Rezaie said.
Ground, naval and air units of Iran's Revolutionary Guards in late April staged the country's largest Gulf wargames.
The exercises, which involved 200,000 members of the guards and Basij militia volunteers, covered four provinces stretching from the mouth of the Gulf to the border with Iraq.
